FBI's Most Wanted Fugitive Apprehended in Punjab

Authorities in Punjab have arrested Manjit Singh Bedi, who was identified by the FBI as one of its most wanted fugitives. The arrest occurred shortly after the FBI reportedly designated Bedi as 'most wanted'. Details regarding the specific charges or the FBI's involvement in the apprehension process were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
